4. Alternative actions which have been considered are:
(1) denial of the application, requiring use of an alternative source of power generation; (2) use of an alternative pumped storage site; (3) use of an alternative method of generation; (4) issuance of a license with adequate conditions to protect and develop the natural resources of the project area.
